data.headline: NotebookLM
data.subheadline: Google's AI that turns docs into podcasts

data.title: What It Does
data.body: Upload your documents, research papers, or notes. NotebookLM analyzes them and generates a natural-sounding podcast discussion between two AI hosts explaining the key concepts.
data.highlight: Perfect for learning complex topics while commuting

data.title: Quick Start
items: Upload your PDFs, docs, or paste text
Get a 5-10 minute podcast in minutes
data.footnote: Free to use with a Google account

data.subtext: Follow for the latest AI productivity hacks
